description: COTRN00C LISTS transactions from the TRANSACT file, although rule R1 requires the migrated class to be called TransactionMenuController: the name comes from the prompt and the behaviour from app/cbl/COTRN00C.cbl. This case isolates the SECOND of the two page-number COMPUTE sites, :317-318, which fires only when the fill loop ends early - a PARTIAL page. First entry (:112 'NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER' is TRUE with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT at zero) sets REENTER at :113, blanks COTRN0AO at :114, performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY at :115 and then SEND-TRNLST-SCREEN at :116. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY reaches WHEN OTHER of the ten-way EVALUATE TRUE at :179 because every SEL000nI is LOW-VALUES, takes the LOW-VALUES branch at :207 for an empty TRNIDINI, zeroes the page number at :224 and performs PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD at :225. ENTER makes the abbreviated combined relation at :285 - 'IF EIBAID NOT = DFHENTER AND DFHPF7 AND DFHPF3' - FALSE, so the anchor READNEXT at :286 is SKIPPED and record one is not consumed; cases 13 and 14 take the other side of that same guard with DFHPF8. All ten row groups are then cleared to SPACES at :290-292 by INITIALIZE-TRAN-DATA (:450-505) BEFORE any of them is filled, which is what makes the unfilled tail observable rather than merely absent. The loop at :297 paints the five seeded records into rows one to five through POPULATE-TRAN-DATA (:381-445) and steps WS-IDX at :301 after each, leaving it at six; the sixth READNEXT reports DFHRESP(ENDFILE) at :639, whose arm sets TRANSACT-EOF, moves the forty-two character literal 'You have reached the bottom of the page...' into WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80) at :642, moves -1 to TRNIDINL at :644 and sends from :645. That arm sets TRANSACT-EOF and NOT WS-ERR-FLG, which is exactly why :283 still admits ENDBR at :322 and the second send at :326 - reading it as an error instead makes the page number wrong. :299 is therefore FALSE, so row six is never populated and WS-IDX stays at six, and the loop exits on TRANSACT-EOF. :305 is FALSE in turn, so the ELSE at :314 runs: :315 SET NEXT-PAGE-NO, and then 'IF WS-IDX > 1' at :316 is TRUE at six, so :317-318 makes the page number one. This is a DISTINCT arithmetic site from :306-307, which fires only while the browse still has more - zero to one in case02, one to two in case14 - and which drags the look-ahead READNEXT at :308 along with it; neither of those runs here. case05 takes the FALSE side of this same :316 guard, where an empty file leaves WS-IDX at one and the page number at ZERO, so the pair together stops an unconditional increment from passing as correct. CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST is written from row one at :393. CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST keeps the sixteen spaces it arrived with, because only :439 writes it and WS-IDX never reached ten - an easily missed consequence of a short page. THREE sends, in this order: :645 from inside the browse paragraph, then :326 (which first moves the page number into PAGENUMI at :324 and a space into TRNIDINO at :325), then :116, which MAIN-PARA performs unconditionally after PROCESS-ENTER-KEY. WS-MESSAGE is never cleared between them, so all three carry the same error line, and :531 truncates it on the RIGHT from PIC X(80) into ERRMSGO PIC X(78) - both widths are pinned, as the two message channels below. Each send is pinned by the six fields POPULATE-HEADER-INFO moves at :571-586, the only items provably identical on every send of one invocation, and the clock behind CURDATEO and CURTIMEO is pinned because :569 reads FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE. No send carries an attribute: COTRN00C copies DFHBMSCA at :81 and never uses it, and it does not copy CSSETATY at all, so no DFHRED and no '*' belongs in any expectation here. Page size ten is behaviour and not configuration - it is the bound at :290 and the 'UNTIL WS-IDX >= 11' at :297. The five seeded rows are the canonical shared seed, each exactly 350 bytes in US-ASCII per app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy, with TRAN-AMT held at scale two and the trailing FILLER X(20) space-filled: drop that span and every offset behind it shifts and the record stops measuring 350. The program browses only - STARTBR, READNEXT, READPREV, ENDBR - so nothing is written, nothing is normalised and no job parameter applies, all three of which are declared empty below rather than left to inference. PROVENANCE: this expectation is STATICALLY DERIVED, by reading app/cbl/COTRN00C.cbl paragraph by paragraph and cross-checking app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy for the record layout, app/cpy-bms/COTRN00.CPY (COTRN0AI at :17, COTRN0AO REDEFINES at :373) and app/bms/COTRN00.bms for the screen widths, and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD (:419) for the CT00-to-COTRN00C binding. It was NEVER captured from a running COBOL program, because this environment has no COBOL runtime able to execute an indexed file, a CICS map or a Language Environment service.
